name: challenges
description: Employee challenges app on Firebase: phone app (mobile/), manager and HR dashboard (dashboard/), shared game rules (shared/) and database rules (firestore.rules).

scripts.test: node --test tests/game.test.js && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-challenges "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.test.js tests/client.test.js"
